notes.title: 2024.10.30demo Notice of delisting
notes.notes:
启禀陛下:
感谢陛下们近期的游玩与建议，臣等在收集问卷和现有的市场建议和方向后初步确认了游戏未来的优化方向与细节。前任工部侍郎叛逃后新任工部侍郎已经上任，但现有demo的版本因不可抗力无法再更新，等将于明日下架demo版本，并进行闭关重制ea版本内容，臣等深知游戏还有许多不足，请陛下宽心，近期臣等会根据现有的开发进度，持续报告开发状态。

Respected Your Majesty:
Thank you to Your Majesty for your recent gameplay and suggestions. After collecting questionnaires and existing market suggestions and directions, we have preliminarily confirmed the optimization direction and details of the game in the future. After the former Minister of Works defected, the new Minister of Works has taken office. However, the current demo version cannot be updated due to force majeure. The demo version will be taken down tomorrow and a closed door remake of the EA version will be carried out. I am well aware that there are still many shortcomings in the game. Please rest assured, Your Majesty. In the near future, I will continue to report on the development status based on the current development progress.

notes.title: 24.10.05demo更新
notes.notes:
启禀陛下，这是这次版本更新的demo开发奏折
这次，臣等主要更新的内容有：
御花园钓鱼小游戏（待优化）
游戏闪退问题优化
师然事业线npc立绘更新
将头发调色模式换成HSV（为了遏制黑恶荧光势力）
全面更改后宫位份名称
优化部分官员职称（发现了差池）
优化光头出现概率（成为稀有卡）
紫宸殿翻牌子立绘自动显示位份最高的妃子
增加紫宸殿臣子互动随机文本
修复错误的按钮名称
人物卡显示爱意 ……
容臣禀告，部分bug和玩法还在不断优化，臣等正在加紧赶制中，请陛下见谅。
下面是臣等的调查问卷，欢迎陛下移步指点臣下：
https://www.wjx.cn/vm/PtHVcRO.aspx# 

Your Majesty, this is the demo development report for this version update
This time, the main updates from Chen and others include:
Royal Garden Fishing Game (to be optimized)
Optimization of Game Flashback Issues
Shi Ran Business Line NPC Vertical Drawing Update
Change the hair color grading mode to HSV (to curb the influence of black and evil fluorescence)
Comprehensively change the name of the harem position
Optimize the professional titles of some officials (discovered discrepancies)
Optimize the probability of bald heads appearing (becoming rare cards)
The Zichen Hall automatically displays the highest ranking concubine by flipping the sign and painting
Add interactive random text for Zichen Palace officials
Fix incorrect button names
The character card displays love
Rongchen reported that some bugs and gameplay are still being optimized, and I am working hard to catch up. Please forgive me, Your Majesty.
The following is the survey questionnaire for the officials. Your Majesty is welcome to step forward and guide the officials:
https://www.wjx.cn/vm/PtHVcRO.aspx#
